name: partner-harness-setup
description: Tier-P (deterministic, agent-free) validation of a DOWNSTREAM partner harness's setup flow against a to-be-published tree. Given a partner harness checkout (a mounted CR_PARTNER_PATH, or a cloned CR_PARTNER_REPO), it asserts the vendored plugin drop is structurally coherent, the partner's read-only `setup check` runs without crashing, and the partner's OWN setup/update test suite passes. Name-free of any specific partner: everything is configurable via CR_PARTNER_* env. A consuming gate is a downstream vendored-plugin sync that runs this before it publishes a re-blit (never ship a drop that breaks the partner's setup flow).

inputs.CR_PARTNER_NAME: partner harness name (report meta). default: partner-harness
inputs.CR_PARTNER_PATH: path to a MOUNTED partner tree inside the box (preferred: validates the exact to-be-published bytes). Takes precedence over CR_PARTNER_REPO.
inputs.CR_PARTNER_REPO: git URL to clone when no CR_PARTNER_PATH is mounted (needs gh/git auth for an internal repo).
inputs.CR_PARTNER_PLUGINS: space-separated vendored plugins to structurally check. default: 'agent-bridge agent-codespaces'
inputs.CR_PARTNER_GOLDEN_DOC: golden-path doc that must exist. default: docs/golden-path/setup.md
inputs.CR_PARTNER_SETUP_ENTRY: read-only setup entrypoint to exercise. default: setup.sh
inputs.CR_PARTNER_CHECK_ARGS: args for the read-only check. default: 'check --non-interactive'
inputs.CR_PARTNER_CHECK_OK_CODES: space-separated exit codes that mean the check RAN + reported a coherent diagnostic (a fresh box legitimately reports missing prereqs). default: '0 1 2'. An interpreter crash (syntax/CRLF/unbound) is caught separately, regardless of code.
inputs.CR_PARTNER_SETUP_TESTS: the partner's OWN setup/update test modules (stdlib unittest). default: 'tests.test_setup_sh tests.test_update_sh'

stages.title: drop structure (plugins parse, marketplace-listed, installers + golden-path present)
partner's OWN setup/update test suite passes

notes: Platform split: this scenario runs the partner's NATIVE-unix setup flow (setup.sh + *_sh tests) in a Linux container via scenario.sh, OR the Windows-native flow (setup.ps1 + *_ps1 tests) in a Windows container via scenario.ps1 (`run.ps1 -Os windows`). Both share the cr-report.json contract. A partner is validated on the platform whose native suite is faithful.
This is a Tier-P gate (no agent, no credits). The agent-driven golden-path (Tier E) eval layers on top later via the same consuming seam.
